concepts.existing_alternative: Use supported accepted art or the current broad Unicode fallback pending a distinct study.

210664: NYC DSA Academy - Red New York: Session 2 of 5: Session 2 will examine the movements of the Gilded Age, including the Henry George mayoralty campaign of 1886, District Assembly 49 of the Knights of Labor, the anarchist movement, the Irish Land League, and the Social Gospel. It will also consider whether anti-capitalist resistance in this period was socialist in perspective and why land was important to left-wing movements in the era.
Tags: Community, History, Education, Politics, Socialism, Class, In Person, Participatory, Format
210665: NYC DSA Academy - Red New York: Session 3 of 5: Session 3 will concentrate on the heyday of socialism in the city, including the Socialist Party, the IWW, Black radicalism in Harlem, Greenwich Village cultural radicalism, uprisings of garment workers, and circles of Progressive reform. The session will explore the connection between the era’s “labor question” and cultural rebellion against conventional middle-class values.
Tags: Community, History, Education, Politics, Socialism, Class, In Person, Participatory, Format
210666: NYC DSA Academy - Red New York: Session 4 of 5: Session 4 will examine the Popular Front of the 1930s and 40s, including New York’s Communist Party, CIO unions, Popular Front groups, left institutions, and the cultural imprint of the Popular Front throughout New York. It will also explore the relationship between the left-wing Popular Front and the transformation of the city under Mayor LaGuardia, and what happened to socialism.
Tags: Community, History, Literature, Education, Politics, Socialism, Class, In Person, Participatory, Format
210667: NYC DSA Academy - Red New York: Session 5 of 5: Session 5 explores the shift from labor-centered left-wing politics to radicalism focused on war, race, and gender, including postwar repression, anti-war and student movements, the Black Panthers, the Young Lords, Stonewall, and the feminist movement. It also examines the role of anti-capitalism in this era’s radicalism and its relationship to DSA.
Tags: Community, History, Education, Politics, Socialism, Class, In Person, Participatory, Format
